title.value: Open Problems in Technical AI Governance
title.justification: The title 'Open Problems in Technical AI Governance' is explicitly mentioned as the title of the paper in the provided content.
title.quote: Open Problems in Technical AI Governance

analysis.description: This paper discusses the technical aspects of AI governance, identifies challenges, and proposes solutions. It provides a taxonomy of subareas, outlines open problems and research questions within each category, and serves as a resource for technical researchers or research funders looking to contribute to AI governance.

type.justification: The paper is primarily theoretical as it introduces new concepts, definitions, and taxonomies related to AI governance without conducting empirical research or experiments.
type.quote: In this paper, we explain what technical AI governance is, outline why it is important, and present a taxonomy and incomplete catalog of its open problems.

name.justification: The main focus of the paper is on AI governance, specifically technical aspects and challenges within the governance of AI systems.
name.quote: In this paper, we aim to catalyse work aimed at addressing such challenges and uncertainties through motivating and introducing the field of technical AI governance (TAIG).

name.justification: A significant portion of the paper involves discussing policy frameworks and potential regulations related to AI.
name.quote: AI progress is creating a growing range of risks and opportunities, but it is often unclear how they should be navigated.

name.justification: The paper discusses various risks associated with AI and methods to manage them, making AI Risk Management a relevant subfield.
name.quote: In particular, we make the following contributions: ... We present a taxonomy of TAIG arranged along two dimensions: capacities, which refer to actions such as access and verification that are useful for governance.
